# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 25 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 25 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_025_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 25

**25:1** The priests were in an uproar over Zechariah's unexplained absence from his regular duties at the temple. They brought out a bowl of water and prayed that God would show them what had happened. They cast lots, and the lot came up for Simeon.

**25:2** Simeon had been given a promise by the Holy Spirit: he would not die before his eyes had seen the Christ in the flesh. When the baby was brought into the temple, Simeon saw him — and he knew. He said: "Lord, you can take me now in peace. My eyes have seen your salvation."

**25:3** I, James, am the one who wrote this account, here in Jerusalem. When the trouble broke out after Herod's death, I went out into the desert and stayed until things calmed down. I give all praise to the Lord God, who gave me this gift and this wisdom.

**25:4** Peace to all who fear the Lord. Amen.

---

*[Scribal colophon — P.Bodmer V:] The Birth of Mary. Revelation of James. Peace to the one who sent it and to the one who reads it.*
